name: Pixies

whyMatters.en: Boston four-piece formed in 1986. Surfer Rosa (Albini) and Doolittle fixed quiet–loud song form; Nirvana and 1990s alt rock cited the map after the first split.
whyMatters.zh: 波士顿四人组，1986 年成立。《Surfer Rosa》（Albini）与《Doolittle》定下强弱曲式；首次解散后 Nirvana 与 1990 年代 alt rock 引用这套地图。

note.en: Surfer Rosa (Steve Albini); clean arpeggio then scream lift; start/stop dynamics.
note.zh: 《Surfer Rosa》（Steve Albini）；干净分解后尖叫抬升；开始/停止动态。

note.en: Doolittle opener; quiet–loud map later cited for 1990s alt rock.
note.zh: 《Doolittle》开场；强弱地图后被 1990 年代 alt rock 引用。

note.en: Deal lead vocal; bass hook as A-side face.
note.zh: Deal 主唱；贝斯钩子当 A 面脸。

interviewQuotes.speaker: Thom Yorke

lyricQuotes: With your feet on the air and your head on the ground

shortBio.en: Quiet–loud alternative, Boston 1986–. Surfer Rosa / Doolittle core; split 1993, reunion 2004; Deal left 2013 for The Breeders.
shortBio.zh: 强弱 alternative，波士顿 1986 年至今。《Surfer Rosa》/《Doolittle》核心；1993 解散、2004 重聚；Deal 2013 离开专注 The Breeders。

body.en:
Pixies formed in Boston after college roommates Black Francis (Charles Thompson IV) and Joey Santiago recruited Kim Deal and David Lovering. Deal answered a bass ad naming Hüsker Dü and Peter, Paul and Mary without having played bass. Drawing on Hüsker Dü and peers Throwing Muses, they cut The Purple Tape, signed to UK 4AD (home of Cocteau Twins), and issued Come On Pilgrim (1987; UK indie No. 5).

Surfer Rosa (1988, Steve Albini) topped the UK indie chart for over a year; taboo lyric and start/stop dynamics reached Kurt Cobain, who later hired Albini for Nirvana’s In Utero. Doolittle (1989) mapped quiet–loud for 1990s alt rock and was the first US hit album. Bossanova (1990) followed as Francis–Deal tension rose; Francis began a solo path (later Frank Black) and Deal led The Breeders. Trompe le Monde (1991)—a Dave Grohl favorite—preceded the 1993 split.

Reputation grew in absence. Reunion 2004 met a large audience; at Coachella, when Radiohead headlined, Thom Yorke compared a Pixies support slot to The Beatles opening. Deal left in 2013 for The Breeders; Kim Shattuck briefly toured on bass, then Paz Lenchantin. Indie Cindy (2014) was the fifth studio album.
body.zh:
大学室友 Black Francis（Charles Thompson IV）与 Joey Santiago 招募 Kim Deal、David Lovering 后，Pixies 在波士顿成立。Deal 应征贝斯广告（文案提到 Hüsker Dü 与 Peter, Paul and Mary）时尚未弹过贝斯。借鉴 Hüsker Dü 并关注同辈 Throwing Muses，录下 The Purple Tape，签入英国 4AD（旗下有 Cocteau Twins），发行《Come On Pilgrim》（1987；英国独立榜第 5）。

《Surfer Rosa》（1988，Steve Albini）居英国独立榜逾一年；禁忌歌词与开始/停止动态传到 Kurt Cobain，后者后来请 Albini 制作 Nirvana《In Utero》。《Doolittle》（1989）为 1990 年代 alt rock 强弱写法提供路线图，并成乐队首张美国热门专。《Bossanova》（1990）时 Francis 与 Deal 关系紧张；Francis 开展个人事业（后改名 Frank Black），Deal 领衔 The Breeders。《Trompe le Monde》（1991）——Dave Grohl 最爱作品之一——之后 1993 年解散。

缺席期间声名上升。2004 年重聚迎来大量听众；科切拉由 Radiohead 主导时，Thom Yorke 称 Pixies 暖场相当于 The Beatles 暖场。2013 年 Deal 离开专注 The Breeders；Kim Shattuck 短暂巡演贝斯后由 Paz Lenchantin 接任。《Indie Cindy》（2014）为第 5 张录音室专。

title.zh: 强弱作为 alternative 曲式

body.en:
Pixies crystallize soft verse / screamed chorus: roaring guitar, sharp pop rhythm, short runtimes. Surfer Rosa and Doolittle land before mass alt radio is ready.

Nirvana and other students convert the map into 1990s commercial alt rock.
body.zh:
Pixies 把安静主歌/尖叫副歌结晶：咆哮吉他、尖锐流行节奏、短时长。《Surfer Rosa》与《Doolittle》面世时大众尚未准备好。

Nirvana 等学生把这套地图转化为 1990 年代商业 alt rock。

body.en:
Francis, Deal, Santiago, Lovering are the Surfer Rosa / Doolittle silhouette. Split 1993; reunion 2004. Deal leaves 2013 for The Breeders; Shattuck briefly, then Paz Lenchantin; Indie Cindy (2014).

Peak citation stays the Doolittle-era four.
body.zh:
Francis、Deal、Santiago、Lovering 是《Surfer Rosa》/《Doolittle》剪影。1993 解散；2004 重聚。Deal 2013 离开专注 The Breeders；Shattuck 短暂后 Paz Lenchantin；《Indie Cindy》（2014）。

峰值引用仍是《Doolittle》时期四人。

alt.zh: Pixies，堪萨斯城，2004 年 10 月 1 日

title.zh: 尖叫、和声贝斯、冲浪噪音主音

body.en:
Francis: barked vocal and guitar. Deal: melodic bass plus Gigantic lead; later The Breeders. Santiago: surf-twang into noise. Lovering: dry punch kit.

Albini on Surfer Rosa; Cobain later books Albini for In Utero.
body.zh:
Francis：吠叫人声与吉他。Deal：旋律贝斯加《Gigantic》主唱；后领衔 The Breeders。Santiago：冲浪颤音进噪音。Lovering：干、砸的鼓。

Albini 制作《Surfer Rosa》；Cobain 后请 Albini 做《In Utero》。

body.en:
Arpeggio hook, Deal harmony, controlled lift on Surfer Rosa—not a full scream wall.

Surfer Rosa face that still shows start/stop dynamics.
body.zh:
《Surfer Rosa》上分解钩子、Deal 和声、受控抬升——非全尖叫墙。

仍展示开始/停止动态的《Surfer Rosa》脸。

body.en:
Doolittle opener. Bass start, scream chorus. College-radio violence at pop length.

Primary citation for 1990s alt quiet–loud grammar.
body.zh:
《Doolittle》开场。贝斯起、尖叫副歌。流行长度的大学电台暴力。

1990 年代 alt 强弱写法的主要引用。

body.en:
Book compares influence scale to Velvet Underground: charts alone understate the reach; admirers named include David Bowie and Radiohead. Cobain cites dynamics and Albini. Deal’s Breeders and Francis’s Frank Black continue after the first split. Yorke’s 2004 Coachella line marks reunion stature.

Boston four as a core 1990s alt writing reference.
body.zh:
书中以 Velvet Underground 作影响尺度对照：销量不能完全衡量；崇拜者包括 David Bowie 与 Radiohead。Cobain 引用动态与 Albini。首次解散后 Deal 的 Breeders 与 Francis 的 Frank Black 继续。Yorke 2004 年科切拉表态标记重聚体量。

波士顿四人组是 1990 年代 alt 写作的核心参照。

note.en: 4AD; Surfer Rosa / Doolittle / Bossanova / Trompe le Monde; split 1993.
Large post-split audience; Coachella 2004 with Radiohead headline context.
note.zh: 解散后扩大的听众；2004 科切拉（Radiohead 主导语境）。

note.en: Deal to The Breeders; Shattuck brief tour bass then Lenchantin; Indie Cindy (2014).
note.zh: Deal 专注 The Breeders；Shattuck 短暂巡演贝斯后 Lenchantin；《Indie Cindy》（2014）。

note.en: Quiet–loud single that became 1990s alt grammar.
note.zh: 成为 1990 年代 alt 写法参照的强弱单曲。

note.en: Soft–loud song form; noise color inside indie length; Albini Surfer Rosa.
note.zh: 强弱曲式；indie 长度里的噪音色彩；Albini《Surfer Rosa》。
